summary_en: Akatsuki (acquirer) completed tender offer for Sunny Side Up Group (ticker 2180) for management integration. Tender period 2026-05-14 to 2026-06-24. 9,355,136 shares and 1,061 warrants tendered, exceeding 5,551,400-share minimum threshold. Akatsuki to acquire all tendered securities, becoming parent company and largest shareholder on 2026-07-01 settlement date with >50% voting stake.
title_en: Notice of Results of Tender Offer for Shares and Warrants of Sunny Side Up Group Inc. by Akatsuki Corporation toward Business Integration and Notice of Changes in Parent Company and Principal Shareholder
translation_en_brief: Akatsuki Corporation completed a tender offer for Sunny Side Up Group Inc. (ticker 2180) to achieve management integration. The tender offer ran from 14 May 2026 to 24 June 2026. A total of 9,355,136 common shares and 1,061 warrants (eighth series, exercisable 2026-10-01 to 2029-09-30) were tendered by shareholders, exceeding the minimum threshold of 5,551,400 shares. The tender offer is now closed and has been approved. Akatsuki will acquire all tendered securities. Settlement commences on 1 July 2026, on which date Akatsuki's voting stake will exceed 50% of total shareholder voting rights, making it Sunny Side Up's parent company and principal shareholder. NextField Inc., which previously held 5,472,000 shares and was a principal shareholder, tendered 1,149,120 of its shares and will cease to be a principal shareholder after settlement. No prior capital or personnel relationships existed between the acquirer and target; a limited commercial relationship (product planning outsourcing) exists between Akatsuki and a Sunny Side Up subsidiary.
